svg.text: Which obligations depend on the classification question, and which do not
Regulation (EU) 2024/1689, consolidated to 27 July 2026
GATE 0 — which regime?
Internal cyber-capability evaluation is not an Annex I or Annex III use case,
so Art. 73 does not bite. The live duty is at the model level: Chapter V.
Art. 75(1a), inserted by the Omnibus, would import Art. 73's day-counts — but only for high-risk systems.
GATE 0.5 — scope and declaration · Arts. 51, 52(1), 53(1)(a)
Run per model. Two models are implicated and they are not in the same position.
Art. 51(2): presumed high-impact above 10²⁵ FLOP. Art. 52(1): notify the Commission
within two weeks — triggered by capability, not market placement.
The only determinate deadline in the GPAI chapter. Resolvable by a single document.
Does not depend on Gate 1.
GATE 1 — is it a 'serious incident'? · Art. 3, point (49)
Four disjunctive limbs. Causal standard: "directly or indirectly leads to".
(b) critical infrastructure — requires serious and irreversible; rebuilding defeats it.
(d) serious harm to property — no irreversibility requirement. The stronger limb.
Verdict: the disclosed record does not resolve this — for either episode.
A boundary the instrument does not draw, not a question the parties answered differently.
yes / arguable
no / unresolved
GATE 2 — Art. 55(1), point (c)
Reached only from Gate 1. Analysed in the alternative.
Three verbs, separately testable:
keep track of · document · report
…without undue delay — no period specified
…and "possible corrective measures to address them"
GATE 3 — obligations that do not depend on the Art. 3(49) classification
55(1)(a) evaluation per standardised protocols, incl. documented adversarial testing
55(1)(b) systemic risk at Union level, including their sources — expressly not single-provider
55(1)(d) cybersecurity — Recital 115 enumerates: "circumvention of safety measures"
55(2) Code of Practice branch, or "alternative adequate means" — either way, artifacts exist
Reached on either branch. These are the rows that cannot be argued away — build them first.
GATE 4 — the instrument · Art. 91 request for information
91(1) own-initiative · 91(3) on a qualified alert from the scientific panel
91(4) required form: legal basis · purpose · information · period · Art. 101 fines
Every unresolved row above is already a question with a settlement condition attached.
